context.story_title: User Can Trigger Study Plan Generation and View the Generated Plan
context.section_tech_spec_epic_3_relevance: This story is the culmination of the AI Study Plan Generation epic, directly implementing: - **AC5:** The system generates a complete study plan (a series of `study_sessions`) based on the topics and user preferences. - **AC6:** A loading indicator is shown while the AI is processing. - **AC7:** A clear error message is shown if plan generation fails for any reason. - **AC8:** The end-to-end plan generation process completes in under 10 seconds. It relies on the FastAPI Backend's `POST /generate-schedule` endpoint which performs the core scheduling logic and Supabase persistence.
context.section_architecture_relevance: As per `solution-architecture.md` and `tech-spec-epic-3.md`, the workflow for plan generation is: **Next.js Frontend (collects all wizard data) --> FastAPI Backend (`POST /generate-schedule`) --> Supabase Database (persists `syllabus_topics` and `study_sessions`).** The FastAPI Backend performs the scheduling and database writes. The Frontend then displays the results. Performance (under 10s) is critical for this end-to-end flow.
context.section_ux_design_specification_relevanc: This story implements **Step 5: "Generation & Completion"** of the "Journey: Initial Study Plan Generation" wizard as described in the UX Design Specification (Section 5.1). It involves: - A "Generate My Plan!" button. - Displaying a "progress indicator". - Closing the wizard and navigating to the dashboard, where the new plan is visible. - A brief success notification. It adheres to UX patterns for "Loading Indicators" (button-specific and initial page load) and "Success Feedback".

context.ui_ux_considerations: The UI for Step 5 ("Generation & Completion") should: - Present a final confirmation screen (e.g., summarizing inputs) with a prominent "Generate My Plan!" button. - Upon clicking the button, immediately: - Disable the button. - Display a clear and persistent progress indicator (e.g., a full-screen overlay with a spinner and a message like "Generating your personalized plan..."). This indicator should be visually engaging and manage user expectations regarding the 10-second NFR. - On successful response: - Close the wizard. - Navigate the user to the relevant dashboard or course page. - Display a brief success toast notification ("Your study plan has been generated!"). - On error response: - Hide the loading indicator. - Display a clear and actionable error message (e.g., a persistent red toast) with suggestions (e.g., "Please try again later or contact support").
context.developer_notes: - **Backend:** - Implement the `POST /generate-schedule` endpoint. - Develop the core scheduling algorithm logic to distribute `topics` into `study_sessions` based on `exam_date` and `user_preferences`. This algorithm must be robust and efficient. - Perform transactional inserts for `syllabus_topics` (if not already done) and `study_sessions` into Supabase. - Ensure `course_id` and `user_id` are correctly linked and RLS is respected. - Prioritize performance to meet the <10s NFR (AC8). - Implement comprehensive error handling for database operations and any internal logic. - **Frontend:** - Aggregate all data from previous wizard steps (`course_id`, `exam_date`, `topics`, `user_preferences`) and construct the request body for `POST /generate-schedule`. - Implement robust loading state management for the API call. - Handle navigation and success/error notifications post-API call. - Ensure the dashboard/course view can correctly fetch and render the newly generated `study_sessions`.
